title: Monte Create
description: A custom-built pack centered on the Create mod, with quality-of-life and exploration enhancements for friends to enjoy!
body:
Welcome to Monte Create!

This is a modpack created for Vincenzo and his friends to build, explore, and create amazing things together.

The heart of this pack is the Create mod, which adds a fantastic world of mechanical components and contraptions. Design sprawling automated factories, build complex machines, or just enjoy the satisfaction of a perfectly engineered system.

To make the adventure even better, the pack also includes:

Enhanced Exploration: Discover new places with JourneyMap and find completely revamped structures with YUNG's Better Dungeons and Overhauled Villages.

Quality of Life: Easily look up recipes with JEI, manage your inventory with Sophisticated Backpacks, and find your way with the Jade UI helper.

Performance & Fun: Includes essential mods like Clumps for smoother XP collection and Comforts for on-the-go sleeping.

This pack is designed to be lightweight and focused, providing the best of Create and exploration without being overwhelming. Have fun!
